title: Unpaid traffic fine
hook: You have an unpaid fine and your licence will be suspended today

opening_line.sms: Traffic Dept: you have an unpaid traffic fine. Pay today to avoid suspension of your licence. Reply to this message for payment options.
opening_line.voice: Hello, this is the traffic department calling about an unpaid fine on your file.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Establish the fine and that it is overdue
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Warn that the licence is suspended today unless the fine is paid now, and offer to settle it immediately
stage_goals.ASK: Say payment needs card verification, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Do you have your card and the code in front of you?
red_flags: The message did not come from an official channel
A threat with a same-day deadline
A request for card details and a one-time code

lesson.headline: The police never ask for your card details or a one-time code
three_points: Fines are paid only through official apps and websites, never by reading a card to a caller.
A deadline of today is a pressure tactic. Real fines do not disappear if you take an hour to check.
Check any fine yourself in the official app before you reply to a message about it.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police
